verdict.rationale: Docs mention a Postman Collection and sandbox for testing API calls, which offers some runnable-example capability, but there's no evidence of an interactive in-browser API reference (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI explorer) — a probe for openapi.json/swagger.json returned 404s. missing for 10: interactive embedded API reference UI, OpenAPI/Swagger spec, in-browser runnable code snippets.
